data.context: In WIPO’s *World Intellectual Property Indicators 2025*, this passage is in the utility model statistics section and lists 2024 utility model applications for the top 20 offices, selected low- and middle-income-country offices, the top 20 origins, and selected low- and middle-income-country origins. The notes explain that an application’s origin is based on the first named applicant’s residence and define ARIPO and D.P.R.K.
